before_after.before: Config 7 correctly separated deliberate blockers from ordinary stale recovery and required substantive post-acquisition progress, but it did not mechanically require current-inbox revision comparison before liveness/no-op classification and did not explicitly define automatic retry semantics after a payload-bound hard approval hold.

rollback.rollback_scope: O_OPERATIONS only; do not roll back DOWNSTREAM_STATE or clean-exploration controls.
